# Pro Vent Air Conditioning WA

> Family-owned Perth air conditioning business specialising in ducted reverse cycle air conditioning. Supply and installation of ducted, split system and evaporative air conditioning, evaporative-to-ducted conversions, and service and repairs for all brands. Covers the Perth CBD and surrounding suburbs, with a lot of experience in Kalamunda and the Perth Hills. ARCtick licence AU59556. 3-year workmanship warranty and 5-year manufacturer's warranty on supplied units.

Phone: 0420 496 791
Email: info@proventairconditioning.com.au

## Ducted air conditioning

- [Ducted air conditioning Perth](https://proventairconditioning.com.au/ducted-air-conditioning): Whole-home ducted reverse cycle installs, zoning with AirTouch 5, how ducted works, FAQs.
- [Ducted air conditioning cost guide](https://proventairconditioning.com.au/ducted-air-conditioning-cost): Installed prices — 2–3 bedroom (7–10kW) $7,000–$12,000; 4 bedroom (10–14kW) $10,000–$15,000; 5+ bedroom (16kW+) $16,000+; double-storey by inspection. Add-on prices and a calculator.
- [Evaporative to ducted reverse cycle conversion](https://proventairconditioning.com.au/evaporative-to-ducted-reverse-cycle): Removing an evaporative cooler ($650 including tile patching), metal roof sheet patching ($800–$1,500), new ducting; usually done in a day.
